nodes.summary: Rewrites GO Classes COA Topic Test 2 attempt snapshots and journal question image links to answer-free practice crops for the target learner. The migration preserves dedicated answer fields and aborts unless exactly 15 attempt rows and 15 question rows are updated.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses a PostgreSQL anonymous DO block with JSONB updates, temporary trigger suspension, string-derived image paths, row-count diagnostics, and an all-or-nothing assertion.
